final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type IN (
    'Edifici adibiti ad albergo, pensione ed attività similari',
    'Collegi, luoghi di ricovero, case di pena, caserme, conventi',
    'Abitazioni adibite a residenza con occupazione saltuaria'
  )
  AND surface_area >= 800
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D')
  AND healthcare >= 75
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: User wants properties near healthcare services (hospitals, pharmacies, clinics). Per the 'near' expression, the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06, rounded to 75).

The user prefers an energy class of D or better, so the filter keeps classes A1 through D. Energy class is used rather than energy_score_class because the score groups B through E together under 3 and cannot express 'D or better'.
